guidance.inspection: Read each located return, destruction, deletion, copying, or retention provision through its full clause structure. Retain governing lead-ins, operative items, exceptions, qualifications, cross-references, and independently repeated provisions. Verify actor, information object, trigger, timing, modality, polarity, and whether each provision creates, restricts, returns, destroys, deletes, or retains copies.

Reconstruct each complete protected-information definition, following text continued across separate spans. Retain its introduction, form and subject-matter enumeration, identification requirement or alternative, and linked qualifications. Keep independently redundant definitions while separating inclusion language from exclusions and unrelated disclosure provisions.

For every development or third-party-source hit, retain the exception or permission preamble, complete operative item, and all access, use, provenance, confidentiality, proof, and timing qualifications. Inspect both definition exclusions and independent sections, retaining every independently operative formulation and necessary heading or cross-reference; do not substitute prior possession or unrelated dealings for development or third-party provenance.

Locate both the operative disclosure or access permission or restriction and any definition of the recipient class. Retain list introductions, recipient items, need-to-know and purpose limits, confidentiality undertakings, cross-references, and independently redundant provisions. Exclude clauses that merely mention an actor without governing that actor's receipt or access.

all_phrases: person to which disclosure is contemplated

guidance.inspection: Read ownership, rights, licence, and permitted-use hits as complete operative provisions. Retain governing headings or lead-ins, the protected object, purpose, exceptions, and independently redundant ownership, no-grant, no-licence, or use-limit clauses. Keep access, disclosure permission, and a limited purpose distinct from an unrestricted rights grant; verify actor, action, scope, modality, and polarity.

any_phrases: not to use exploit or employ

guidance.inspection: Inspect restrictions concerning the existence, occurrence, status, terms, or public announcement of negotiations, discussions, agreements, or a contemplated transaction. Retain the governing nondisclosure lead-in, consent and audience limitations, exceptions, and every independently responsive list item, excluding siblings about different subject matter.

Collect every clause continuing obligations after termination, expiration, completion, abandonment, return, or destruction. Retain split duration text, affected obligations, endpoints, exceptions, retained-material continuity, accrued-rights language, and independently redundant continuity or enforceability provisions; distinguish these from a bare termination right.

Read the complete compelled-disclosure condition and notice duty. Retain exception or list preambles, legal or regulatory triggers, notice timing and recipient, opportunity to seek protection, and same-mechanism follow-on limits. Separate compelled notice from unauthorized-disclosure notice and bare permission to disclose.

any_phrases: as much notice of this disclosure as possible

guidance.inspection: Inspect every solicitation occurrence for actor, target, prohibited action, duration, approval condition, and exceptions. From a matched restriction, follow its clause forward through every enumerated target and qualification even when later items omit the solicitation word; retain its governing preamble. Keep separately operative employment and proxy restrictions, while rejecting headings, definitions, or exceptions that do not supply a restriction.

For each hit, read the entire numbered clause from its trigger or governing lead-in through every operative item, exception, retention carve-out, qualification, and continuation term. Retain independently repeated provisions. Verify actor, protected object, trigger, timing, modality, polarity, and whether the text requires return, destruction, deletion, or erasure; permits or restricts copying; or permits retention.

operations.rationale: Broadens acquisition to Confidential Data, erasure, backup, and approval formulations while requiring reconstruction of triggers, complete lists, retention exceptions, and distinct copy polarity.

guidance.inspection: Reconstruct each protected-information definition across all continued spans. Retain its definitional introduction, every governed form or subject-matter item, identification rule and alternative, negative consequence, and linked qualification. Distinguish a broad definition of Information from the definition that makes it protected, and keep independently operative definitions without importing unrelated uses or disclosures.

operations.rationale: Adds protected-data and identification formulations and makes forward reconstruction of fragmented definitions and enumerations explicit, addressing missed introductions, continuations, and negative marking rules.

guidance.inspection: For each development or provenance hit, retain the governing exclusion or permission preamble, the complete operative item, and every access, use, independence, source, confidentiality, proof, and timing qualification. Inspect definition exclusions and independent permissions separately. Verify whether the actor developed information or received it from another source; do not substitute prior possession, vendor-origin protected information, or unrelated dealings.

operations.rationale: Separates development from third-party provenance and adds recurring source-other-than and availability formulations that earlier queries missed or confused with prior possession and vendor data.

guidance.inspection: Locate both the operative permission or restriction governing receipt or access and any definition of the recipient class. Retain disclosure lead-ins, all governed recipient items, need-to-know and purpose limits, confidentiality undertakings, liability terms, cross-references, and independently repeated permissions. A class definition or actor mention alone is only a lead; verify who may disclose what to whom and on what conditions.

all_phrases: do not apply to the disclosure

operations.rationale: Adds direct may-disclose, exception, need-to-know, and internal-staff formulations while requiring the operative permission and recipient definition to be retained together.

guidance.inspection: Read each ownership, rights, licence, or use hit as a complete operative provision. Retain governing lead-ins, protected objects, stated purposes, exceptions, unrestricted-use clauses, and independently redundant ownership or no-grant clauses. Verify actor, action, scope, modality, and polarity; keep disclosure permission, limited use, unrestricted residual use, ownership, and licence grants distinct.

operations.rationale: Adds sole-purpose and unrestricted-residual formulations and strengthens inspection against confusing use permission with a rights grant or missing independently redundant ownership evidence.

guidance.inspection: Inspect confidentiality treatment and disclosure restrictions concerning an agreement's existence or terms, negotiations or discussions, contemplated transactions, prospective interest, and related announcements. Retain definitional deeming language as well as operative restrictions, consent requirements, audiences, exceptions, and independently responsive provisions. Do not require the word negotiation when the protected fact is the agreement or prospective interest itself.

operations.rationale: Covers definitional confidentiality and prospective-interest announcements that do not use the same negotiation vocabulary, while preserving their complete consent and exception structure.

guidance.inspection: Collect every independently operative clause continuing obligations after termination, expiration, completion, return, destruction, or retention. Retain split lead-ins, affected obligations, duration and endpoints, exceptions, retained-material restrictions, and accrued-rights language. Follow a continuation clause through every enumerated endpoint; distinguish continuing duties from a bare termination right or mere possession.

operations.rationale: Adds beyond-termination and retained-material continuity wording and explicitly requires complete split endpoints, addressing empty retrievals and omitted continuation members.

guidance.inspection: Reconstruct the complete compelled-disclosure mechanism, including an exception or list preamble, legal or regulatory trigger, notice or consultation duty, timing, recipient, protective-order opportunity, and linked limits. Follow cross-references in both directions when the trigger and duty are split. Verify that notice concerns compelled disclosure, rejecting unauthorized-use or breach notices and bare disclosure permission.

operations.rationale: Adds consultation, operation-of-law, and split cross-reference formulations while sharpening the distinction between compelled-disclosure notice and unauthorized-disclosure notice.

Retain the preamble and all responsive items even when later items omit the solicitation word. Keep employment solicitation and proxy solicitation separately complete; reject headings or definitions without an operative restriction.

operations.rationale: Improves acquisition of employ-without-solicit wording and makes full traversal of governed target and standstill lists mandatory, addressing repeated omissions after visible preambles.
